## Internal constitutive Jacobians (Table 3)

> Of 32 distinct UMAT implementations examined, 8 carry a local Newton solve; 6 had their internal Jacobian extracted and verified against centred differences of the residual at the identical local state, over 8 separate executions, and none disagreed. Counts are of implementations rather than appearances: the same UMAT is reachable from more than one origin, and running it from each with different upstream material is repeated validation of one model.
